pieces.Text: Familiarity with the military traditions of your homeland inspires uncommon valor in you. Gain temporary combat bonuses after resisting fear effects.

Familiarity with the military traditions of your homeland inspires uncommon valor in you. You gain a +2 bonus on all saving throws against fear effect. Whenever a fear effect targets you and fails to affect you (either because of a successful saving throw or because of immunity to fear), you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and CMB checks against the creature that attempted to use the fear affect on you for 1 round.
